subject.title: fix(cli): bound media input file reads with per-file and aggregate budget

question: Should existing capability-CLI `--file` users be subject to fixed non-configurable 100 MiB per-file and 500 MiB aggregate limits, and if so what documented supported input contract is acceptable?
rationale: The patch fixes a real resource-risk class but intentionally makes formerly accepted inputs fail; selecting the supported limit and upgrade behavior is product compatibility policy rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Approve a documented bounded-input contract
options.body: Choose supported per-file and aggregate limits, document the resulting capability-CLI behavior, and require descriptor-bound implementation plus real command proof.

options.title: Avoid a new hard cap
options.body: Pursue a streaming or capability-specific input design that keeps existing large-input workflows supported without unbounded whole-file allocations.

recommendation.title: Approve a documented bounded-input contract
recommendation.body: Choose supported per-file and aggregate limits, document the resulting capability-CLI behavior, and require descriptor-bound implementation plus real command proof.
